messages:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — AlphaThera sent back their vendor security questionnaire. They need DPA + SOC2 evidence, plus a network isolation diagram and our KMS rotation cadence. Deadline: EOD Friday. Link: https://docs.company/alpha-thera-questionnaire :eyes:
Liam Chen: can you drop the questionnaire here? I want to check what they mean by 'network isolation diagram' — might be the Private deployment diagram we already have.@Anika can you confirm acceptable KMS docs?
Maya Patel: pasted the doc ^ — it's the vendor form, page 3 has the network/KMS asks. They specifically call out: "diagram of tenant isolation between hosted/dedicated/private" and "KMS key rotation window and proof of last rotation"
Jordan Reyes: I can export the private deployment network diagram from the infra repo. Will include overlay showing VPC peering and firewall rules. ETA 2pm today. :white_check_mark:
Anika Roy: For KMS rotation, Legal/Compliance accepts either: 1) signed attestation + KMS rotation policy excerpt, or 2) audit log showing key rotation event within last 365 days plus policy. We usually send the policy + rotation log snippet. I'll prepare language.
Maya Patel: perfect — can we include the retention statement for embeddings/token logs? They asked about retention limits for user data in hosted inference. Suggest: "embedding vectors retained for up to 30 days for cache, logs aggregated for 90 days" — confirm? @Liam
Liam Chen: that retention wording is fine but change "cache" -> "prefix/KV cache" otherwise it's vague. Also add: "customers on Dedicated/Private can configure retention via Console or API".
Maya Patel: updated wording noted. Jordan — please ensure diagrams have a small legend and call out "no cross-tenant storage of KV cache" explicitly.
Jordan Reyes: got it. I'll add a short note in the diagram PDF and upload to the shared drive: s3://redwood-evidence/alpha-thera/diagrams/tenant-isolation.pdf
ComplianceBot: Evidence checklist generated for thread 2113456789: ITEMS -> [DPA, SOC2 summary, Network diagram, KMS rotation log, Retention statement]. See /evidence-checklists/2113456789.
Anika Roy: I'll draft the cover email and attach the SOC2 summary (we can send the scoped SOC2 summary + control mapping). Maya — do we want to include the SOC2 carve-outs for hosted vs private?
Maya Patel: yes include a quick note: "SOC2 scope excludes on-prem components; hosted and Dedicated are in scope". Keep it 1–2 lines. Also add requester contact: alpha-contacts@alphathera.com
Liam Chen: I'll grab the SOC2 summary PDF and a short control mapping (CSV) from the compliance repo and drop both by 3pm.
Maya Patel: thanks team. Plan: Jordan uploads diagram by 2pm, Liam uploads SOC2 docs by 3pm, Anika will finish cover email by 4pm. I'll send the package to the customer with ComplianceBot checklist attached. If anything slips, ping here. :pray:
Jordan Reyes: uploaded diagram to s3, link above. Added legend and explicit "no cross-tenant KV cache" note.
Liam Chen: uploaded SOC2-summary.pdf and control-mapping.csv to s3://redwood-evidence/alpha-thera/controls/ -- I also exported a small KMS rotation log snippet (redacted) to s3://redwood-evidence/alpha-thera/kms/rotation_log.txt
Anika Roy: draft email done, dropping here for review:
```
Hi AlphaThera security team,

Attached: DPA, SOC2 summary (scoped), network isolation diagram, KMS rotation log excerpt, retention statement.

Short notes:
- SOC2 covers Hosted & Dedicated; Private deployments are customer-managed where noted.
- KV cache is not shared across tenants; retention settings are configurable.

Please let us know if you need more granular logs or additional attestations.

Thanks,
Maya + Red team
```
Maya Patel: looks good to me. Minor edit: change "Private deployments are customer-managed where noted" -> "Private deployments are customer-managed and fall outside hosted SOC2 scope".
Anika Roy: edited. final draft attached to s3://redwood-evidence/alpha-thera/packets/final-email-draft.txt
ComplianceBot: Submission-ready package validated (basic checks passed) for thread 2113456789. ETA to customer: sending after Maya approval.
Maya Patel: approving to send. I'll attach the checklist and send shortly. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
